_comment: Claim-fidelity spec for impl: a representative implementation run must emit the canonical ran-pass closeout token after executing verification. The current workflow keeps the normal contract and slice-ordering gist inline; reference metadata records conditional depth and does not require ceremonial document reads.
prompt: /charness:impl tests/ 에 scripts/claim_fidelity_lib.py 의 헬퍼 함수(_validate_string_list 의 빈-리스트·중복 거부, _validate_engagement 의 on-demand trigger 필수 규칙)를 직접 호출해 검증하는 deterministic 단위 테스트를 — 기존 registry 레벨 테스트(tests/quality_gates/test_claim_fidelity_specs.py)와 겹치지 않는 추가 커버리지로 — 작은 슬라이스로 더하고 실제로 실행해서 증명해줘. 가장 강한 정직한 경로로 검증하고, 증명하지 못한 동작은 명시적으로 unverified로 남기고, Lint Gate 상태와 completion-report 카테고리로 closeout 한 뒤 멈추기 전에 stop gate critique까지 돌려줘.

adapter-contract.md.rationale: Repository-specific verification defaults are needed only when the adapter exists or the slice cannot use the ordinary local path.
adapter-contract.md.trigger: When .agents/impl-adapter.yaml exists or must be created for repository-specific verification expectations.

contract-consumption.md.rationale: Every implementation starts from the current slice contract, while the root workflow carries the short ingestion order and normal carry-forward fields inline.

design-lenses.md.rationale: Every slice gets a small ownership and seam check from the inline workflow; this reference supplies deeper heuristics only when the interface shape is genuinely uncertain.

external-api-contract.md.rationale: This reference narrows the verification path for third-party request and response seams and is irrelevant to local-only changes.
external-api-contract.md.trigger: When the slice adds or changes calls to a third-party API.

sequence-discipline.md.rationale: The workflow orders each slice toward the highest-leverage seam; this reference adds recovery and freeze-delay heuristics only when ordering tension is real.
